originalTitle: What Is Behind The Move In Cameco Stock?

Cameco (CCJ) stock fell 7.9% on Friday, October 30, 2026, while the S&P 500 lost 1.8%. The decline occurred on the day Cameco reported its third-quarter results, during a session when all five companies on its peer list also fell between 4.4% and 6.8%. Management said the results were largely in line with what it had expected. So what did the quarter actually show?

Cameco’s Gross Margin Fell During A Planned Mill Outage

While revenue for the third quarter of 2026 was 0.7% higher than a year earlier, Cameco kept less of each dollar after production costs. Gross margin, the share of sales left after the cost of producing them, declined to 19.7% from 27.7% the prior year.

Management said results for the quarter were lower than a year earlier, and that this decline was expected. The company pointed to a longer planned maintenance outage at the Key Lake mill, which brought lower production volumes and higher costs in the quarter.

Management also adjusted its 2026 outlook as the year nears its end, narrowing the range for annual uranium deliveries to 29.5 million to 30.5 million pounds. With its operational guidance changes, the company now expects higher administrative costs and higher average unit costs of sales for the year.

Did Cameco Fall Alone Or With Peers?

Cameco dropped alongside its peers and recorded the steepest loss of the group. All five companies on its Trefis peer list fell during the session, ranging from a 4.4% decline for NexGen Energy to a 6.8% drop for Denison Mines.

Energy stocks broadly moved in the opposite direction. The SPDR energy sector fund (XLE), which tracks Cameco’s sector, rose 1.9% while the S&P 500 fell. The session’s decline was shared across Cameco’s peer group, rather than the wider energy sector.

A decline of this magnitude is unusual for Cameco. Over the 365 days prior to this session, the stock fell this much or more on two days, most recently dropping 9.3% on June 5, 2026.

The latest drop left Cameco at $76.91, its lowest close of the past year, compared with a high close of $134.09 on January 28, 2026. Over the past twelve months the stock has lost 27.7%, while the S&P 500 returned 11.3%. All of that loss, and more, came after May 1, 2026: since then the shares are down 36.2%.

Cameco’s next report covers its fourth quarter of 2026. Gross margin is the figure to watch, given the higher unit costs management now expects for the year.

Cameco (CCJ) 股票于 2026 年 10 月 30 日星期五下跌 7.9%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.8%。下跌发生在 Cameco 报告第三季度业绩的当天，当时其同行名单上的所有五家公司的股价也下跌了 4.4% 至 6.8% 之间。管理层表示，结果基本符合预期。那么该季度实际显示了什么？

Cameco 的毛利率因工厂计划停运而下降

尽管 2026 年第三季度的收入比上年同期增长 0.7%，但扣除生产成本后，Cameco 的每一美元成本都减少了。毛利率（扣除生产成本后剩余的销售额份额）从上一年的 27.7% 下降至 19.7%。

管理层表示，本季度业绩低于去年同期，这种下降是预料之中的。该公司指出，基湖工厂的计划维护停电时间较长，导致本季度产量下降和成本上升。

随着2026年接近尾声，管理层还调整了2026年的展望，将年度铀交付量范围缩小至2950万至3050万磅。随着运营指引的变化，该公司目前预计今年的管理成本和平均单位销售成本将更高。

卡梅科是独自倒下还是与同伴一起倒下？

Cameco 的跌幅与同行齐平，是该集团中跌幅最大的。 Trefis 同行名单上的所有五家公司在盘中均下跌，NexGen Energy 下跌 4.4%，Denison Mines 下跌 6.8%。

能源股普遍向相反方向波动。追踪 Cameco 行业的 SPDR 能源行业基金 (XLE) 上涨 1.9%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌。 Cameco 的同行群体（而非更广泛的能源行业）共同下跌了该交易日。

对于 Cameco 来说，如此大幅度的下滑是不寻常的。在本次交易之前的 365 天里，该股有两天下跌了这么多或更多，最近一次下跌是在 2026 年 6 月 5 日，下跌了 9.3%。

最近的下跌使 Cameco 的收盘价为 76.91 美元，为过去一年的最低收盘价，而 2026 年 1 月 28 日的最高收盘价为 134.09 美元。在过去 12 个月中，该股下跌了 27.7%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 11.3%。所有这些损失以及更多损失都发生在 2026 年 5 月 1 日之后：自那时起，该股下跌了 36.2%。

Cameco 的下一份报告涵盖 2026 年第四季度。考虑到管理层目前预计今年的单位成本较高，毛利率值得关注。
